profiles.title: External SSH / ssh-agent
profiles.notes: Recommended. Uses SSH keys configured outside Audion Hub Manager.

profiles.title: HTTPS via Git Credential Manager
profiles.notes: Useful behind restrictive networks. Credentials are handled by GCM/OS, not by this app.

profiles.title: External GUI auth / VS Code / GitKraken
profiles.notes: Hub Manager only detects and uses already-working Git auth.
